items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I remember I was twelve years old when I first heard his music... I just grabbed all the recordings of his I could and learned it by ear

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m telling you, there’s nothing like [knocks on desk] on the piano doing Jerry Lee Lewis. That is just like a joy.

Well yeah, I remember I was twelve years old when I first heard his music. I bought this Billboard rock & roll set. It was 1957 through ’61 and I mean for pure enjoyment the ‘50s is just — I love that era. I love the music, I love the styles and but yeah, “Whole Lotta Shakin’” and “Great Balls of Fire” were on there. And I just remember number one it made me happy. It was just such a great sound, a great groove, a great pocket. And it wasn’t until my early twenties that I wanted to learn how to do that properly.…
